text:
Olga (Finance): FYI vendor 'ResellUK Ltd' billed 20% UK VAT on our hosted API consumption (INV-RUK-1109). They claim they're an agent for US vendor 'CloudMatrix' and charged VAT at point of sale. Holding payment. cc @Drew Tax @Hannah Legal
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-RUK-1109 uploaded by @ResellUK Ltd total:  4,800 (VAT 800). File: INV-RUK-1109.pdf
Drew Tax: Quick list of docs to validate agency/reseller treatment: 1) copy of agency/reseller agreement showing agent vs principal wording; 2) ResellUK VAT reg number + VIES screenshot; 3) underlying supplier invoice from CloudMatrix or primary supplier showing who supplied the service; 4) evidence that ResellUK acted as agent (no mark-up on VAT, client-facing receipts). Without that, they should not levy VAT on behalf of a non-UK principal.
Hannah Legal: Legally we need to see explicit agency clause and routing of funds evidence. If ResellUK is the principal on paper, their VAT charge may be valid. If they're a disclosed agent selling on behalf of CloudMatrix (US), the place-of-supply rules and VAT treatment change. Also check whether Redwood entity billed is UK-registered or Redwood Ltd vs Redwood Inc.
Marta (EMEA Ops): Vendor replied and attached: (a) ResellUK VAT: GB998877665, (b) a one-page reseller agreement (unsigned) stating they "resell products from CloudMatrix" and (c) a screenshot of their billing rule. They did NOT attach CloudMatrix's supplier invoice.
Drew Tax: I'll run the VIES check on GB998877665. Also next step: request either the CloudMatrix supplier invoice or a signed agency agreement that confirms ResellUK is acting purely as agent and that CloudMatrix is the supplier. If CloudMatrix is non-UK and the supply is B2B to our UK entity, reverse charge or no UK VAT may apply depending on who is the supplier.
Drew Tax: VIES lookup: GB998877665 returns VALID. That confirms ResellUK's registration but not the underlying supply chain.
Olga (Finance): Putting INV-RUK-1109 on hold. Please request the following from ResellUK with 5 business day SLA: 1) signed agency agreement naming CloudMatrix as principal, 2) the original invoice from CloudMatrix showing supply to ResellUK or to Redwood, 3) confirmation whether any VAT was remitted by ResellUK to HMRC for this invoice. If they cannot provide, request immediate refund of VAT charged.
Hannah Legal: Suggested vendor copy: "Please reissue a corrected invoice or provide the CloudMatrix supplier invoice and a signed agency agreement within 5 business days. If you acted as agent for CloudMatrix, please either (a) reissue without UK VAT showing CloudMatrix as supplier, or (b) provide proof VAT was correctly remitted. Otherwise we require refund of the VAT element immediately."
Marta (EMEA Ops): Sending vendor message now. Noting procurement contact in case of commercial pushback.
Olga (Finance): Logged hold in refunds tracker. Will release hold only after either corrected invoice attached or refund proof. Escalate to procurement/legal if vendor refuses.
InvoiceBot: Payment hold recorded: PH-235111-01 for INV-RUK-1109.
Drew Tax: If they push back and claim agency but can't prove it, we should consider a chargeback and keep a record for VAT reclaim if needed. I'll flag in the tax binder once vendor responds.
Olga (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll update thread when vendor responds or when credit posts.
